description: Returns the engagement on a post of a connected LinkedIn or Instagram account. postId is the id of a post as listed in a posts result. kind=comments (default) lists comments with author, text and reaction counters, ordered by sortBy; kind=reactions lists reactors with their reaction; commentId lists the reactions on that comment. Comment text arrives between untrusted-content markers. The author.id and sender.id values are provider person ids that identify people in a profile lookup. Paginated with cursor (from next_cursor) or offset, plus limit. A nonexistent post or comment id can surface as a generic provider error rather than a not-found message.

commentId.description: The id of a comment on the post, as listed with kind=comments. When set, lists the reactions on that comment and kind is ignored

connectedAccountId.description: The id of a connected workspace account with provider LinkedIn or Instagram and status 'ok'

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's next_cursor

kind.description: Which engagement to list on the post: 'comments' (default) or 'reactions'. Ignored when commentId is set, which returns the reactions on that comment

offset.description: Pagination offset, for results without a cursor

postId.description: The id of the post, as listed in a posts result

sortBy.description: Comment ordering: MOST_RECENT or MOST_RELEVANT (comments listing only)

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: get_social_post_engagement

total.description: The provider's count of every matching row, present only when the provider reports one

title: Get social post engagement
